newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends little changed in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends little changed in active trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed little changed on Wednesday but dealers expected turnover to be active in the near term after stock market regulators authorised the inflow of nearly US$1 billion in foreign capital.
The local unit closed at T$27.491 to the U.S. dollar against Tuesday's T$27.495. Turnover was US$214.5 million.
Dealers saw some selling of U.S. dollars and expect more demand for the local unit as newly approved foreign funds flow into the stock market in coming months.

Taiwan's Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday authorised inflows of US$997 million in foreign funds for the stock market, a record for one batch of approvals. The funds must be invested in Taiwan with six months.
"Foreign funds may strengthen the Taiwan dollar, but there is also U.S. dollar demand from importers," said one dealer.
A T$27.48-52 trading range was seen for Thursday.
